title: CoupledL2 keeps a continuously valid stalled beat stable

source.statement: When CoupledL2 keeps valid asserted across a stalled cycle, it keeps the selected channel beat unchanged until acceptance.

trigger_event.description: valid is asserted while ready is deasserted

response_event.description: valid remains asserted on the following cycle

preconditions: valid remains asserted across the stalled cycle

required_observations.description: selected CoupledL2 channel changed a continuously valid stalled beat
